verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם וּמֶ֖לֶךְ אֵ֣ין בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיְהִ֣י׀ אִ֣ישׁ לֵוִ֗י גָּ֚ר בְּיַרְכְּתֵ֣י הַר־ אֶפְרַ֔יִם וַיִּֽקַּֽח־ לוֹ֙ אִשָּׁ֣ה פִילֶ֔גֶשׁ מִבֵּ֥ית לֶ֖חֶם יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bay·yā·mîm hā·hêm ū·me·leḵ ’ên bə·yiś·rā·’êl way·hî ’îš lê·wî gār bə·yar·kə·ṯê har- ’ep̄·ra·yim way·yiq·qaḥ- lōw ’iš·šāh p̄î·le·ḡeš mib·bêṯ le·ḥem yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: Now in those days when there was no king in Israel . . . . . . a Levite who lived in the remote hill country of Ephraim took for himself a concubine from Bethlehem in Judah
verses.literalPt: ACONTECEU também naqueles dias, em que não havia rei em Israel, que houve um homem levita, que, peregrinando aos lados da montanha de Efraim, tomou para si uma concubina, de Belém de Judá.

verses.original: וַתִּזְנֶ֤ה עָלָיו֙ פִּֽילַגְשׁ֔וֹ וַתֵּ֤לֶךְ מֵֽאִתּוֹ֙ אֶל־ בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֔יהָ אֶל־ בֵּ֥ית לֶ֖חֶם יְהוּדָ֑ה וַתְּהִי־ שָׁ֕ם יָמִ֖ים אַרְבָּעָ֥ה חֳדָשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiz·neh ‘ā·lāw pî·laḡ·šōw wat·tê·leḵ mê·’it·tōw ’el- bêṯ ’ā·ḇî·hā ’el- bêṯ le·ḥem yə·hū·ḏāh wat·tə·hî- šām yā·mîm ’ar·bā·‘āh ḥo·ḏā·šîm
verses.literal: But she was unfaithful to him and left him to return to her father’s house in Bethlehem in Judah After she had been there four months
verses.literalPt: Porém a sua concubina adulterou contra ele, e deixando-o, foi para a casa de seu pai, em Belém de Judá, e esteve ali alguns dias, a saber, quatro meses.

verses.original: וַיָּ֨קָם אִישָׁ֜הּ וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ אַחֲרֶ֗יהָ לְדַבֵּ֤ר עַל־ לִבָּהּ֙ לַהֲשִׁיבוֹ וְנַעֲר֥וֹ עִמּ֖וֹ וְצֶ֣מֶד חֲמֹרִ֑ים וַתְּבִיאֵ֙הוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֔יהָ וַיִּרְאֵ֙הוּ֙ אֲבִ֣י הַֽנַּעֲרָ֔ה וַיִּשְׂמַ֖ח לִקְרָאתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām ’î·šāh way·yê·leḵ ’a·ḥă·re·hā lə·ḏab·bêr ‘al- lib·bāh la·hă·šī·ḇō wə·na·‘ă·rōw ‘im·mōw wə·ṣe·meḏ ḥă·mō·rîm wat·tə·ḇî·’ê·hū bêṯ ’ā·ḇî·hā way·yir·’ê·hū ’ă·ḇî han·na·‘ă·rāh way·yiś·maḥ liq·rā·ṯōw
verses.literal: her husband got up and went after her to speak kindly to her and bring her back taking his servant . . . and a pair of donkeys So the girl brought him into her father’s house and when her father saw him he gladly welcomed him
verses.literalPt: E seu marido se levantou, e foi atrás dela, para lhe falar conforme ao seu coração, e para tornar a trazê-la; e o seu moço e um par de jumentos iam com ele; e ela o levou à casa de seu pai, e, vendo-o o pai da moça, alegrou-se ao encontrar-se com ele.

verses.original: וַיֶּחֱזַק־ בּ֤וֹ חֹֽתְנוֹ֙ אֲבִ֣י הַֽנַּעֲרָ֔ה וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב אִתּ֖וֹ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֑ים וַיֹּאכְלוּ֙ וַיִּשְׁתּ֔וּ וַיָּלִ֖ינוּ שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ye·ḥĕ·zaq- bōw ḥō·ṯə·nōw ’ă·ḇî han·na·‘ă·rāh way·yê·šeḇ ’it·tōw šə·lō·šeṯ yā·mîm way·yō·ḵə·lū way·yiš·tū way·yā·lî·nū šām
verses.literal: His father-in-law the girl’s father persuaded him to stay . . . so he remained with him three days eating drinking and lodging there
verses.literalPt: E seu sogro, o pai da moça, o deteve, e ficou com ele três dias; e comeram e beberam, e passaram ali a noite.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הָרְבִיעִ֔י וַיַּשְׁכִּ֥ימוּ בַבֹּ֖קֶר וַיָּ֣קָם לָלֶ֑כֶת וַיֹּאמֶר֩ אֲבִ֨י הַֽנַּעֲרָ֜ה אֶל־ חֲתָנ֗וֹ סְעָ֧ד לִבְּךָ֛ פַּת־ לֶ֖חֶם וְאַחַ֥ר תֵּלֵֽכוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bay·yō·wm hā·rə·ḇî·‘î way·yaš·kî·mū ḇab·bō·qer way·yā·qām lā·le·ḵeṯ way·yō·mer ’ă·ḇî han·na·‘ă·rāh ’el- ḥă·ṯā·nōw sə·‘āḏ lib·bə·ḵā paṯ- le·ḥem wə·’a·ḥar tê·lê·ḵū
verses.literal: On the fourth day they got up early in the morning and prepared to depart but the girl’s father said to his son-in-law Refresh your heart with a morsel of bread and then you can go
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que ao quarto dia pela manhã, de madrugada, ele levantou-se para partir; então o pai da moça disse a seu genro: Fortalece o teu coração com um bocado de pão, e depois partireis.

verses.original: וַיֵּשְׁב֗וּ וַיֹּאכְל֧וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֛ם יַחְדָּ֖ו וַיִּשְׁתּ֑וּ וַיֹּ֜אמֶר אֲבִ֤י הַֽנַּעֲרָה֙ אֶל־ הָאִ֔ישׁ הֽוֹאֶל־ נָ֥א וְלִ֖ין וְיִטַ֥ב לִבֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·šə·ḇū way·yō·ḵə·lū šə·nê·hem yaḥ·dāw way·yiš·tū way·yō·mer ’ă·ḇî han·na·‘ă·rāh ’el- hā·’îš hō·w·’el- nā wə·lîn wə·yi·ṭaḇ lib·be·ḵā
verses.literal: So they sat down and the two of them ate and drank together Then the girl’s father said to the man Please agree to stay overnight and let your heart be merry
verses.literalPt: Assentaram-se, pois, e comeram ambos juntos, e beberam; e disse o pai da moça ao homem: Peço-te que ainda esta noite queiras passá-la aqui, e alegre-se o teu coração.

verses.original: וַיָּ֥קָם הָאִ֖ישׁ לָלֶ֑כֶת וַיִּפְצַר־ בּוֹ֙ חֹתְנ֔וֹ וַיָּ֖שָׁב וַיָּ֥לֶן שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām hā·’îš lā·le·ḵeṯ way·yip̄·ṣar- bōw ḥō·ṯə·nōw way·yā·šāḇ way·yā·len šām
verses.literal: The man got up to depart but his father-in-law . . . persuaded him so he stayed there that night
verses.literalPt: Porém o homem levantou-se para partir; mas seu sogro o constrangeu a tornar a passar ali a noite.

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֨ם בַּבֹּ֜קֶר בַּיּ֣וֹם הַחֲמִישִׁי֮ לָלֶכֶת֒ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר׀ אֲבִ֣י הַֽנַּעֲרָ֗ה סְעָד־ נָא֙ לְבָ֣בְךָ֔ וְהִֽתְמַהְמְה֖וּ עַד־ נְט֣וֹת הַיּ֑וֹם וַיֹּאכְל֖וּ שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaš·kêm bab·bō·qer bay·yō·wm ha·ḥă·mî·šî lā·le·ḵeṯ way·yō·mer ’ă·ḇî han·na·‘ă·rāh sə·‘āḏ- nā lə·ḇā·ḇə·ḵā wə·hiṯ·mah·mə·hū ‘aḏ- nə·ṭō·wṯ hay·yō·wm way·yō·ḵə·lū šə·nê·hem
verses.literal: On the fifth day he got up early in the morning to depart but the girl’s father said Please refresh your heart So they waited until late afternoon . . . and the two of them ate
verses.literalPt: E, madrugando ao quinto dia pela manhã para partir, disse o pai da moça: Ora, conforta o teu coração. E detiveram-se até já declinar o dia; e ambos juntos comeram.

verses.original: וַיָּ֤קָם הָאִישׁ֙ לָלֶ֔כֶת ה֥וּא וּפִילַגְשׁ֖וֹ וְנַעֲר֑וֹ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֣וֹ חֹתְנ֣וֹ אֲבִ֣י הַֽנַּעֲרָ֡ה הִנֵּ֣ה נָא֩ רָפָ֨ה הַיּ֜וֹם לַעֲרֹ֗ב לִֽינוּ־ נָ֞א הִנֵּ֨ה חֲנ֤וֹת הַיּוֹם֙ לִ֥ין פֹּה֙ וְיִיטַ֣ב לְבָבֶ֔ךָ וְהִשְׁכַּמְתֶּ֤ם מָחָר֙ לְדַרְכְּכֶ֔ם וְהָלַכְתָּ֖ לְאֹהָלֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām hā·’îš lā·le·ḵeṯ hū ū·p̄î·laḡ·šōw wə·na·‘ă·rōw way·yō·mer lōw ḥō·ṯə·nōw ’ă·ḇî han·na·‘ă·rāh hin·nêh nā rā·p̄āh hay·yō·wm la·‘ă·rōḇ lî·nū- nā hin·nêh ḥă·nō·wṯ hay·yō·wm lîn pōh wə·yî·ṭaḇ lə·ḇā·ḇe·ḵā wə·hiš·kam·tem mā·ḥār lə·ḏar·kə·ḵem wə·hā·laḵ·tā lə·’ō·hā·le·ḵā
verses.literal: When the man got up to depart . . . with his concubine and his servant his father-in-law the girl’s father said to him Look the day is drawing to a close Please spend the night . . . See the day is almost over Spend the night here that your heart may be merry Then you can get up early tomorrow for your journey . . . home
verses.literalPt: Então o homem levantou-se para partir, ele, e a sua concubina, e o seu moço; e disse-lhe seu sogro, o pai da moça: Eis que já o dia declina e a tarde já vem chegando; peço-te que aqui passes a noite; eis que o dia já vai acabando, passa aqui a noite, e que o teu coração se alegre; e amanhã de madrugada levanta-te a caminhar, e irás para a tua tenda.

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ אָבָ֤ה הָאִישׁ֙ לָל֔וּן וַיָּ֣קָם וַיֵּ֗לֶךְ וַיָּבֹא֙ עַד־ נֹ֣כַח יְב֔וּס הִ֖יא יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְעִמּ֗וֹ צֶ֤מֶד חֲמוֹרִים֙ חֲבוּשִׁ֔ים וּפִילַגְשׁ֖וֹ עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ’ā·ḇāh hā·’îš lā·lūn way·yā·qām way·yê·leḵ way·yā·ḇō ‘aḏ- nō·ḵaḥ yə·ḇūs hî yə·rū·šā·lim wə·‘im·mōw ṣe·meḏ ḥă·mō·w·rîm ḥă·ḇū·šîm ū·p̄î·laḡ·šōw ‘im·mōw
verses.literal: But the man was unwilling . . . to spend the night He got up and departed and arrived . . . opposite Jebus (that is Jerusalem) with his two saddled donkeys and his concubine
verses.literalPt: Porém o homem não quis ali passar a noite, mas levantou-se, e partiu, e chegou até defronte de Jebus (que é Jerusalém), e com ele o par de jumentos albardados, como também a sua concubina.

verses.original: הֵ֣ם עִם־ יְב֔וּס וְהַיּ֖וֹם רַ֣ד מְאֹ֑ד וַיֹּ֨אמֶר הַנַּ֜עַר אֶל־ אֲדֹנָ֗יו לְכָה־ נָּ֛א וְנָס֛וּרָה אֶל־ עִֽיר־ הַיְבוּסִ֥י הַזֹּ֖את וְנָלִ֥ין בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: hêm ‘im- yə·ḇūs wə·hay·yō·wm raḏ mə·’ōḏ way·yō·mer han·na·‘ar ’el- ’ă·ḏō·nāw lə·ḵāh- nā wə·nā·sū·rāh ’el- ‘îr- hay·ḇū·sî haz·zōṯ wə·nā·lîn bāh
verses.literal: When they were near Jebus and the day was almost gone the servant said to his master . . . Please let us stop at this Jebusite city and spend the night here
verses.literalPt: Estando, pois, já perto de Jebus, e tendo-se já declinado muito o dia, disse o moço a seu SENHOR: Vamos agora, e retiremo-nos a esta cidade dos jebuseus, e passemos ali a noite.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ אֲדֹנָ֔יו לֹ֤א נָסוּר֙ אֶל־ עִ֣יר נָכְרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא־ מִבְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵ֑נָּה וְעָבַ֖רְנוּ עַד־ גִּבְעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw ’ă·ḏō·nāw lō nā·sūr ’el- ‘îr nā·ḵə·rî ’ă·šer lō- mib·bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl hên·nāh wə·‘ā·ḇar·nū ‘aḏ- giḇ·‘āh
verses.literal: But his master replied We will not turn aside to the city of foreigners where there are no Israelites . . . . . . We will go on to Gibeah
verses.literalPt: Porém disse-lhe seu senhor: Não nos retiraremos a nenhuma cidade estranha, que não seja dos filhos de Israel; mas iremos até Gibeá.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְנַעֲר֔וֹ לְךָ֥ וְנִקְרְבָ֖ה בְּאַחַ֣ד הַמְּקֹמ֑וֹת וְלַ֥נּוּ בַגִּבְעָ֖ה א֥וֹ בָרָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lə·na·‘ă·rōw lə·ḵå̄ wə·niq·rə·ḇāh bə·’a·ḥaḏ ham·mə·qō·mō·wṯ wə·lan·nū ḇag·giḇ·‘āh ’ōw ḇā·rā·māh
verses.literal: He continued Come let us try to reach one of these towns to spend the night in Gibeah or Ramah
verses.literalPt: Disse mais a seu moço: Vamos, e cheguemos a um daqueles lugares, e passemos a noite em Gibeá ou em Ramá.

verses.original: וַיַּעַבְר֖וּ וַיֵּלֵ֑כוּ וַתָּבֹ֤א לָהֶם֙ הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ אֵ֥צֶל הַגִּבְעָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְבִנְיָמִֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aḇ·rū way·yê·lê·ḵū wat·tā·ḇō lā·hem haš·še·meš ’ê·ṣel hag·giḇ·‘āh ’ă·šer lə·ḇin·yā·min
verses.literal: So they continued on their journey and the sun set as they neared Gibeah in Benjamin
verses.literalPt: Passaram, pois, adiante, e caminharam, e o sol se lhes pôs junto a Gibeá, que é cidade de Benjamim.

verses.original: וַיָּסֻ֣רוּ שָׁ֔ם לָב֖וֹא לָל֣וּן בַּגִּבְעָ֑ה וַיָּבֹ֗א וַיֵּ֙שֶׁב֙ בִּרְח֣וֹב הָעִ֔יר וְאֵ֥ין אִ֛ישׁ מְאַסֵּֽף־ אוֹתָ֥ם הַבַּ֖יְתָה לָלֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·su·rū šām lā·ḇō·w lā·lūn bag·giḇ·‘āh way·yā·ḇō way·yê·šeḇ bir·ḥō·wḇ hā·‘îr wə·’ên ’îš mə·’as·sêp̄- ’ō·w·ṯām hab·bay·ṯāh lā·lūn
verses.literal: They stopped . . . to go in and lodge in Gibeah The Levite went in and sat down in the city square but no one would take them into his home for the night
verses.literalPt: E retiraram-se para lá, para passarem a noite em Gibeá; e, entrando ele, assentou-se na praça da cidade, porque não houve quem os recolhesse em casa para ali passarem a noite.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֣ה׀ אִ֣ישׁ זָקֵ֗ן בָּ֣א מִֽן־ מַעֲשֵׂ֤הוּ מִן־ הַשָּׂדֶה֙ בָּעֶ֔רֶב וְהָאִישׁ֙ מֵהַ֣ר אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְהוּא־ גָ֖ר בַּגִּבְעָ֑ה וְאַנְשֵׁ֥י הַמָּק֖וֹם בְּנֵ֥י יְמִינִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh ’îš zā·qên bā min- ma·‘ă·śê·hū min- haś·śā·ḏeh bā·‘e·reḇ wə·hā·’îš mê·har ’ep̄·ra·yim wə·hū- ḡār bag·giḇ·‘āh wə·’an·šê ham·mā·qō·wm bə·nê yə·mî·nî
verses.literal: That evening an old man from the hill country of Ephraim . . . who was residing in Gibeah the men of that place were Benjamites came in from his work in the field
verses.literalPt: E eis que um velho homem vinha à tarde do seu trabalho do campo; e era este homem da montanha de Efraim, mas peregrinava em Gibeá; eram porém os homens deste lugar filhos de Benjamim.

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂ֣א עֵינָ֗יו וַיַּ֛רְא אֶת־ הָאִ֥ישׁ הָאֹרֵ֖חַ בִּרְחֹ֣ב הָעִ֑יר וַיֹּ֨אמֶר הָאִ֧ישׁ הַזָּקֵ֛ן אָ֥נָה תֵלֵ֖ךְ וּמֵאַ֥יִן תָּבֽוֹא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·śā ‘ê·nāw way·yar ’eṯ- hā·’îš hā·’ō·rê·aḥ bir·ḥōḇ hā·‘îr way·yō·mer hå̄·ʾīš haz·zā·qên ’ā·nāh ṯê·lêḵ ū·mê·’a·yin tā·ḇō·w
verses.literal: When he looked up . . . and saw the traveler in the city square the old man asked Where are you going and where have you come from
verses.literalPt: Levantando ele, pois, os olhos, viu a este viajante na praça da cidade, e disse o ancião: Para onde vais, e donde vens?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו עֹבְרִ֨ים אֲנַ֜חְנוּ מִבֵּֽית־ לֶ֣חֶם יְהוּדָה֮ עַד־ יַרְכְּתֵ֣י הַר־ אֶפְרַיִם֒ מִשָּׁ֣ם אָנֹ֔כִי וָאֵלֵ֕ךְ עַד־ בֵּ֥ית לֶ֖חֶם יְהוּדָ֑ה וְאֶת־ בֵּ֤ית יְהוָה֙ אֲנִ֣י הֹלֵ֔ךְ וְאֵ֣ין אִ֔ישׁ מְאַסֵּ֥ף אוֹתִ֖י הַבָּֽיְתָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw ‘ō·ḇə·rîm ’ă·naḥ·nū mib·bêṯ- le·ḥem yə·hū·ḏāh ‘aḏ- yar·kə·ṯê har- ’ep̄·ra·yim miš·šām ’ā·nō·ḵî wā·’ê·lêḵ ‘aḏ- bêṯ le·ḥem yə·hū·ḏāh wə·’eṯ- bêṯ Yah·weh ’ă·nî hō·lêḵ wə·’ên ’îš mə·’as·sêp̄ ’ō·w·ṯî hab·bā·yə·ṯāh
verses.literal: The Levite replied . . . We are traveling from Bethlehem in Judah to the remote hill country of Ephraim where I am from I went to Bethlehem in Judah and now I am going to the house of the LORD but no one has taken me into his home
verses.literalPt: E ele lhe disse: Viajamos de Belém de Judá até aos lados da montanha de Efraim, de onde sou; porquanto fui a Belém de Judá, porém agora vou à casa do SENHOR; e ninguém há que me recolha em casa,

verses.original: וְגַם־ תֶּ֤בֶן גַּם־ מִסְפּוֹא֙ יֵ֣שׁ לַחֲמוֹרֵ֔ינוּ וְ֠גַם לֶ֣חֶם וָיַ֤יִן יֶשׁ־ לִי֙ וְלַֽאֲמָתֶ֔ךָ וְלַנַּ֖עַר עִם־ עֲבָדֶ֑יךָ אֵ֥ין מַחְס֖וֹר כָּל־ דָּבָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam- te·ḇen gam- mis·pō·w yêš la·ḥă·mō·w·rê·nū wə·ḡam le·ḥem wā·ya·yin yeš- lî wə·la·’ă·mā·ṯe·ḵā wə·lan·na·‘ar ‘im- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā ’ên maḥ·sō·wr kāl- dā·ḇār
verses.literal: even though there is both straw and feed for our donkeys and bread and wine . . . for me and the maidservant and young man with me There is nothing that we, your servants . . . . . . lack
verses.literalPt: Todavia temos palha e pasto para os nossos jumentos, e também pão e vinho há para mim, e para a tua serva, e para o moço que vem com os teus servos; de coisa nenhuma há falta.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר הָאִ֤ישׁ הַזָּקֵן֙ שָׁל֣וֹם לָ֔ךְ רַ֥ק כָּל־ מַחְסוֹרְךָ֖ עָלָ֑י רַ֥ק בָּרְח֖וֹב אַל־ תָּלַֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hā·’îš haz·zā·qên šā·lō·wm lāḵ raq kāl- maḥ·sō·wr·ḵā ‘ā·lāy raq bā·rə·ḥō·wḇ ’al- tā·lan
verses.literal: Peace to you said the old man Let me supply . . . everything you need Only do not spend the night in the square
verses.literalPt: Então disse o ancião: Paz seja contigo; tudo quanto te faltar fique ao meu cargo; tão-somente não passes a noite na praça.

verses.original: וַיְבִיאֵ֣הוּ לְבֵית֔וֹ וַיָּ֖בָול לַחֲמוֹרִ֑ים וַֽיִּרְחֲצוּ֙ רַגְלֵיהֶ֔ם וַיֹּאכְל֖וּ וַיִּשְׁתּֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḇî·’ê·hū lə·ḇê·ṯōw way·yå̄·ḇå̄·wl la·ḥă·mō·w·rîm way·yir·ḥă·ṣū raḡ·lê·hem way·yō·ḵə·lū way·yiš·tū
verses.literal: So he brought him to his house and fed his donkeys And they washed their feet and ate and drank
verses.literalPt: E levou-o à sua casa, e deu pasto aos jumentos; e, lavando-se os pés, comeram e beberam.

verses.original: הֵמָּה֮ מֵיטִיבִ֣ים אֶת־ לִבָּם֒ וְהִנֵּה֩ אַנְשֵׁ֨י הָעִ֜יר אַנְשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי־ בְלִיַּ֗עַל נָסַ֙בּוּ֙ אֶת־ הַבַּ֔יִת מִֽתְדַּפְּקִ֖ים עַל־ הַדָּ֑לֶת וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ אֶל־ הָ֠אִישׁ בַּ֣עַל הַבַּ֤יִת הַזָּקֵן֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הוֹצֵ֗א אֶת־ הָאִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֥א אֶל־ בֵּיתְךָ֖ וְנֵדָעֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hêm·māh mê·ṭî·ḇîm ’eṯ- lib·bām wə·hin·nêh ’an·šê hā·‘îr ’an·šê ḇə·nê- ḇə·lî·ya·‘al nā·sab·bū ’eṯ- hab·ba·yiṯ miṯ·dap·pə·qîm ‘al- had·dā·leṯ way·yō·mə·rū ’el- hā·’îš ba·‘al hab·ba·yiṯ haz·zā·qên lê·mōr hō·w·ṣê ’eṯ- hā·’îš ’ă·šer- bā ’el- bê·ṯə·ḵā wə·nê·ḏā·‘en·nū
verses.literal: While they were enjoying themselves suddenly the wicked men of the city - surrounded the house Pounding on the door they said to the old man who owned the house Bring out the man who came to your house so we can have relations with him
verses.literalPt: Estando eles alegrando o seu coração, eis que os homens daquela cidade (homens que eram filhos de Belial) cercaram a casa, batendo à porta; e falaram ao ancião, senhor da casa, dizendo: Tira para fora o homem que entrou em tua casa, para que o conheçamos.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֣א אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם הָאִישׁ֙ בַּ֣עַל הַבַּ֔יִת וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם אַל־ אַחַ֖י אַל־ תָּרֵ֣עוּ נָ֑א אַ֠חֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֞א הָאִ֤ישׁ הַזֶּה֙ אַל־ בֵּיתִ֔י אַֽל־ תַּעֲשׂ֖וּ אֶת־ הַנְּבָלָ֥ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê ’ă·lê·hem hā·’îš ba·‘al hab·ba·yiṯ way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem ’al- ’a·ḥay ’al- tā·rê·‘ū nā ’a·ḥă·rê ’ă·šer- bā hā·’îš haz·zeh ’al- bē·ṯī ’al- ta·‘ă·śū ’eṯ- han·nə·ḇā·lāh haz·zōṯ
verses.literal: The owner of the house went out and said to them No my brothers do not do this wicked thing . . . After all this . . . man is a guest in my house Do not commit this outrage
verses.literalPt: E o homem, dono da casa, saiu a eles e disse-lhes: Não, irmãos meus, ora não façais semelhante mal; já que este homem entrou em minha casa, não façais tal loucura.

verses.original: הִנֵּה֩ בִתִּ֨י הַבְּתוּלָ֜ה וּפִֽילַגְשֵׁ֗הוּ אוֹצִֽיאָה־ נָּ֤א אוֹתָם֙ וְעַנּ֣וּ אוֹתָ֔ם וַעֲשׂ֣וּ לָהֶ֔ם הַטּ֖וֹב בְּעֵינֵיכֶ֑ם וְלָאִ֤ישׁ הַזֶּה֙ לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ דְּבַ֖ר הַנְּבָלָ֥ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ḇit·tî hab·bə·ṯū·lāh ū·p̄î·laḡ·šê·hū ’ō·w·ṣî·’āh- nā ’ō·w·ṯām wə·‘an·nū ’ō·w·ṯām wa·‘ă·śū lā·hem haṭ·ṭō·wḇ bə·‘ê·nê·ḵem wə·lā·’îš haz·zeh lō ṯa·‘ă·śū də·ḇar han·nə·ḇā·lāh haz·zōṯ
verses.literal: Look let me bring out my virgin daughter and the man’s concubine - and you can use them and do with them as you wish But do not do such a vile thing to this man
verses.literalPt: Eis que a minha filha virgem e a concubina dele vo-las tirarei fora; humilhai-as a elas, e fazei delas o que parecer bem aos vossos olhos; porém a este homem não façais essa loucura.

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ אָב֤וּ הָאֲנָשִׁים֙ לִשְׁמֹ֣עַֽ ל֔וֹ וַיַּחֲזֵ֤ק הָאִישׁ֙ בְּפִ֣ילַגְשׁ֔וֹ וַיֹּצֵ֥א אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם הַח֑וּץ וַיֵּדְע֣וּ א֠וֹתָהּ וַיִּֽתְעַלְּלוּ־ בָ֤הּ כָּל־ הַלַּ֙יְלָה֙ עַד־ הַבֹּ֔קֶר וַֽיְשַׁלְּח֖וּהָ בַּעֲלוֹת הַשָּֽׁחַר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ’ā·ḇū hā·’ă·nā·šîm liš·mō·a‘ lōw way·ya·ḥă·zêq hā·’îš bə·p̄î·laḡ·šōw way·yō·ṣê ’ă·lê·hem ha·ḥūṣ way·yê·ḏə·‘ū ’ō·w·ṯāh way·yiṯ·‘al·lə·lū- ḇāh kāl- hal·lay·lāh ‘aḏ- hab·bō·qer way·šal·lə·ḥū·hā ba·ʿă·lōṯ haš·šā·ḥar
verses.literal: But the men would . . . not listen to him So the Levite took his concubine and sent her outside to them and they raped her and abused her throughout the night - and at dawn . . . they let her go
verses.literalPt: Porém aqueles homens não o quiseram ouvir; então aquele homem pegou da sua concubina, e lha tirou para fora; e eles a conheceram e abusaram dela toda a noite até pela manhã, e, subindo a alva, a deixaram.

verses.original: וַתָּבֹ֥א הָאִשָּׁ֖ה לִפְנ֣וֹת הַבֹּ֑קֶר וַתִּפֹּ֞ל פֶּ֧תַח בֵּית־ הָאִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ אֲדוֹנֶ֥יהָ שָּׁ֖ם עַד־ הָאֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·ḇō hā·’iš·šāh lip̄·nō·wṯ hab·bō·qer wat·tip·pōl pe·ṯaḥ bêṯ- hā·’îš ’ă·šer- ’ă·ḏō·w·ne·hā šām ‘aḏ- hā·’ō·wr
verses.literal: Early that morning . . . the woman went back to the house where her master was staying collapsed at the doorway and lay there until it was light . . .
verses.literalPt: E ao romper da manhã veio a mulher, e caiu à porta da casa daquele homem, onde estava seu senhor, e ficou ali até que se fez claro.

verses.original: וַיָּ֨קָם אֲדֹנֶ֜יהָ בַּבֹּ֗קֶר וַיִּפְתַּח֙ דַּלְת֣וֹת הַבַּ֔יִת וַיֵּצֵ֖א לָלֶ֣כֶת לְדַרְכּ֑וֹ וְהִנֵּ֧ה הָאִשָּׁ֣ה פִֽילַגְשׁ֗וֹ נֹפֶ֙לֶת֙ פֶּ֣תַח הַבַּ֔יִת וְיָדֶ֖יהָ עַל־ הַסַּֽף׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām ’ă·ḏō·ne·hā bab·bō·qer way·yip̄·taḥ dal·ṯō·wṯ hab·ba·yiṯ way·yê·ṣê lā·le·ḵeṯ lə·ḏar·kōw wə·hin·nêh hā·’iš·šāh p̄î·laḡ·šōw nō·p̄e·leṯ pe·ṯaḥ hab·ba·yiṯ wə·yā·ḏe·hā ‘al- has·sap̄
verses.literal: In the morning when her master got up and opened the doors of the house to go out . . . on his journey there was his concubine collapsed in the doorway of the house with her hands on the threshold
verses.literalPt: E, levantando-se seu senhor pela manhã, e abrindo as portas da casa, e saindo a seguir o seu caminho, eis que a mulher, sua concubina, jazia à porta da casa, com as mãos sobre o limiar.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר אֵלֶ֛יהָ ק֥וּמִי וְנֵלֵ֖כָה וְאֵ֣ין עֹנֶ֑ה וַיִּקָּחֶ֙הָ֙ עַֽל־ הַחֲמ֔וֹר וַיָּ֣קָם הָאִ֔ישׁ וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ לִמְקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·le·hā qū·mî wə·nê·lê·ḵāh wə·’ên ‘ō·neh way·yiq·qā·ḥe·hā ‘al- ha·ḥă·mō·wr way·yā·qām hā·’îš way·yê·leḵ lim·qō·mōw
verses.literal: Get up he told her . . . Let us go But there was no response So the man . . . put her on his donkey and set out for home
verses.literalPt: E ele lhe disse: Levanta-te, e vamo-nos, porém ela não respondeu; então, levantando-se o homem a pôs sobre o jumento, e foi para o seu lugar.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣א אֶל־ בֵּית֗וֹ וַיִּקַּ֤ח אֶת־ הַֽמַּאֲכֶ֙לֶת֙ וַיַּחֲזֵ֣ק בְּפִֽילַגְשׁ֔וֹ וַֽיְנַתְּחֶ֙הָ֙ לַעֲצָמֶ֔יהָ לִשְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר נְתָחִ֑ים וַֽיְשַׁלְּחֶ֔הָ בְּכֹ֖ל גְּב֥וּל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ’el- bê·ṯōw way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- ham·ma·’ă·ḵe·leṯ way·ya·ḥă·zêq bə·p̄î·laḡ·šōw way·nat·tə·ḥe·hā la·‘ă·ṣā·me·hā liš·nêm ‘ā·śār nə·ṯā·ḥîm way·šal·lə·ḥe·hā bə·ḵōl gə·ḇūl yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: When he reached . . . his house he picked up a knife took hold of his concubine cut her limb by limb into twelve . . . pieces and sent her throughout the territory of Israel
verses.literalPt: Chegando, pois, à sua casa, tomou um cutelo, e pegou na sua concubina, e a despedaçou com os seus ossos em doze partes; e enviou-as por todos os termos de Israel.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה כָל־ הָרֹאֶ֗ה וְאָמַר֙ לֹֽא־ נִהְיְתָ֤ה וְלֹֽא־ נִרְאֲתָה֙ כָּזֹ֔את לְמִיּ֞וֹם עֲל֤וֹת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם עַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה שִֽׂימוּ־ לָכֶ֥ם עָלֶ֖יהָ עֻ֥צוּ וְדַבֵּֽרוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ḵāl hā·rō·’eh wə·’ā·mar lō- nih·yə·ṯāh wə·lō- nir·’ă·ṯāh kā·zōṯ lə·mî·yō·wm ‘ă·lō·wṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim ‘aḏ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh śî·mū- lā·ḵem ‘ā·le·hā ‘u·ṣū wə·ḏab·bê·rū
verses.literal: And everyone who saw it said Nothing like this has been seen or done from the day the Israelites . . . came out of the land of Egypt until this day Think it over . . . . . . take counsel and speak up
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que cada um que via aquilo dizia: Nunca tal se fez, nem se viu desde o dia em que os filhos de Israel subiram da terra do Egito, até ao dia de hoje; ponderai isto, considerai, e falai.
